headline: Approved minutes of two earlier meetings and a consent agenda of staff hires and resignations.
summary: The meeting covered a superintendent report on upcoming school events and a public comment on personnel. Members heard an update on teacher hiring for 2026-2027 and approved two sets of minutes and a consent agenda of staff hires and resignations. No new business was reported.
decisions: Approved the July 7, 2026 regular meeting minutes as written; the motion carried.
Approved the June 10, 2026 special meeting minutes; the motion carried.
Approved the consent agenda, including personnel hires and resignations, by unanimous vote.

decision_evidence.quote: The Board of Education voted to approve the July 7, 2026 -Regular Meeting Minutes as written. Motion made by Kara Ledger and second by Robert Parenti. The motion carried.
The Board of Education voted to approve the June 10, 2026 -Special Meeting Minutes Motion made by Kara Ledger and second by Robert Parenti. The motion carried.
Vice Chair Tagariello called for a motion to approve the consent agenda, which include items from 6.1.a to 6.1.f. Motion made by Robert Parenti and second by Kara Ledger. Motion passed unanimously.
